greeting: You fly home today, Dan: Dubrovnik behind you, Tampa by late afternoon. The two things worth nailing down before you land are a car and a bed for tonight.

needsAttention.title: A rental car for the landing
needsAttention.detail: You touch down at Tampa around 3:55 PM, and the Sept 20 – Oct 5 full-size SUV is still marked open in Todoist. If it isn't booked before you're on the ground, it's walk-up rates on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Where you sleep tonight in St. Pete
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–21 landing-gap lodging is still flagged open in Todoist. The girls aren't picked up until Tuesday, so tonight and tomorrow night both need a room near St. Pete before the Orlando villa starts.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: Your 15-min board sweep on Meet — but it overlaps your transatlantic leg, so you may be in the air.

schedule.title: Land in Tampa
schedule.detail: FRA to TPA, gate C14 — the Croatia trip closed out and back on Florida ground.

flagged.title: Public-policy roles in your LinkedIn alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn pushed an SVP, Global Public Policy alert and similar roles this morning — worth a scan once you land.

flagged.title: Venmo request from Joshua Weaver
flagged.detail: $50 for mowing (9-17-26) is sitting unpaid in Venmo.

flagged.title: No milk delivery this Friday
flagged.detail: The Maine Milkman is off Fri Sept 25; deliveries resume Oct 2.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and newsletters — Indochino, NYT Cooking, FT, Dermstore, a stack of shop sales.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: Autumn baking weather — warm spice and dried fruit suit the turning season.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas rental (full-size SUV, PWM)
Sort Disney park tickets for Sept 26–27
Plan a grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: Over the Atlantic after the Dubrovnik red-eye; the 9 AM board sweep with Mike lands mid-flight.
Wheels down at Tampa just before four, then the drive into St. Pete.
First night back in Florida before Tuesday's pickup — settle in and confirm the car and tonight's room.
